items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: The Lions, they was located on Dumaine right where Lopez got the Undertaker part.

ctx.x: Of course, the Bulls Club isn't like the Knights of Peter Claibor.

Oh, no, no, no, that's mostly a secret organization. The Bulls Club is nothing but a pleasure organization. It's like the Hop Goblins. And then we had the Sanders Centers, that was all pleasure clubs. Were you in there? I was a member of the Sanders Centers. Really? I didn't know that. Yeah, I was a member of the Sanders Centers for years and years. And we had this, when they was on Dumaine Street, and there was another of them down. The Lions, they was located on Dumaine right where Lopez got the Undertaker…
I've never heard of that. Was it a pleasure club?
